name: Wikipedia
description: Search Wikipedia, navigate article sections, and read section text and infoboxes.
author: WebMCP Anywhere

tools.name: wiki_search
tools.title: Search Wikipedia
tools.description: Search Wikipedia (same language edition as the current page) for a query. If there is an exact article title match Wikipedia opens that article directly, otherwise a search results page opens. The page reloads. Returns the URL that was opened.

tools.name: wiki_article
tools.title: Article summary
tools.description: Read the current Wikipedia article's `title`, its `url`, and the `summary` (up to 3 lead paragraphs before the first section heading). Read-only.

tools.name: wiki_sections
tools.title: List sections
tools.description: List the top-level section headings (h2) of the current Wikipedia article, in page order. Returns `sections` (array of heading strings) to pass to wiki_open_section / wiki_read_section.

tools.name: wiki_open_section
tools.title: Scroll to section
tools.description: Scroll the current Wikipedia article to the section whose heading contains the given text (case-insensitive; exact matches preferred). Returns the matched `heading` and the first 2 paragraphs of the section in `preview`.

tools.name: wiki_read_section
tools.title: Read section
tools.description: Read the text of a section of the current Wikipedia article by heading (case-insensitive contains match on h2 headings). Returns `heading` and `paragraphs` (array of paragraph strings from the section, including its subsections, up to `paragraphs` count, default 8). Read-only.

heading.description: Section heading text, e.g. "Early life" (from wiki_sections).

paragraphs.description: Maximum number of paragraphs to read (1-50).

tools.name: wiki_infobox
tools.title: Read infobox
tools.description: Read the infobox (the fact table at the top right of many Wikipedia articles). Returns `rows` (array of strings; each is a label followed by its value, e.g. "Capital Paris") and the infobox `caption`. Returns rows = [] if the article has no infobox. Read-only.

tools.name: wiki_links
tools.title: List article links
tools.description: List internal article links from the body of the current Wikipedia article (first N in page order). Returns `titles` and `urls` arrays. Read-only.

tools.name: wiki_random
tools.title: Random article
tools.description: Open a random Wikipedia article (Special:Random). The page reloads; call wiki_article afterwards to read it. Returns the URL that was requested.
